name: capstone
description: Architecture reference docs: a docs/capstone/ index plus topic files stamped to commits, kept current by generate/sync (formerly docs/check-docs), plus doctor/review, a greenfield pipeline from product mockup to running code with a frontend-design stage, and a doc-grounded feature chain.

interface.shortDescription: Living architecture reference docs for any codebase
interface.longDescription: Generates and maintains a descriptive architecture reference: a lean docs/capstone/ index plus per-topic files (architecture, models, conventions, data-flow, dependencies, testing, operations, glossary), each stamped with the git commit it was derived at and refreshed only when its covered paths change. Companion skills keep the docs fresh, repair the docs area, run one opt-in review with architecture and UI sides, carry an exhaustive greenfield design interview from product mockup to running code, and take a single feature from idea to merged code against the docs.
defaultPrompt: Generate the architecture reference for this codebase.
Are the architecture docs still up to date?
